preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: MIX
  description: Mix ingredients, except NaHCO3, cysteine·HCl and Na2S·9H2O, and adjust
    pH to 6.0.
- step_number: 2
  action: HEAT
  description: Bring to a boil for 5-10 sec, then, cool down under a stream of H2-CO2
    (80:20) and add NaHCO3 to the medium.
- step_number: 3
  action: ALIQUOT
  description: Dispense the medium into suitable culture vessels (e.g., 20 ml of the
    medium in 120 ml serum bottles) under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20) and seal with
    butyl rubber stoppers.
- step_number: 4
  action: STORE
  description: After autoclaving, stand the medium overnight.
- step_number: 5
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Separately autoclave cysteine·HCl and Na2S·9H2O as 5% solutions, respectively,
    under a N2 atmosphere.
- step_number: 6
  action: MIX
  description: Prior to inoculation, aseptically and anaerobically add the cysteine·HCl
    and Na2S·9H2O solutions.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: HEAT
  description: Mix ingredients, except NaHCO3, L-Cysteine·HCl·H2O and Na2S·9H2O, and
    bring to a boil for 5-10 sec.
- step_number: 2
  action: COOL
  description: Cool down under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20), and add NaHCO3 to the medium.
- step_number: 3
  action: ALIQUOT
  description: Dispense the medium into suitable culture vessels (e.g., 20 ml of the
    medium in 120 ml serum bottles) under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20) and seal with
    butyl rubber stoppers.
- step_number: 4
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Separately autoclave cysteine·HCl and Na2S·9H2O as 5% solutions, respectively,
    under a N2 atmosphere.
- step_number: 5
  action: MIX
  description: Prior to inoculation, aseptically and anaerobically add the cysteine·HCl
    and Na2S·9H2O solutions.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: MIX
  description: Mix ingredients, except sulfur and Na2S·9H2O, and adjust pH to 6.0
    with H2SO4.
- step_number: 2
  action: FILTER
  description: Sterilize the medium by filtration.
- step_number: 3
  action: HEAT
  description: Steam sulfur for 3 hr on each of 3 successive days.
- step_number: 4
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Neutralize Na2S·9H2O as a 5% solution, and autoclave under a N2 atmosphere.
- step_number: 5
  action: ALIQUOT
  description: Distribute the medium and sulfur into culture vessels (e.g., 20 ml
    of the medium in 120 ml serum bottles) under a stream of H2-CO2 (4:1, v/v) gas
    mixture and seal with butyl rubber stoppers.
- step_number: 6
  action: MIX
  description: Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S·9H2O solution, and readjust
    pH to 6.0 with sterile 1 N H2SO4.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: HEAT
  description: Mix ingredients, except NaHCO3, L-cysteine·HCl·H2O and Na2S·9H2O, and
    bring to a boil for 5-10 sec.
- step_number: 2
  action: COOL
  description: Cool down under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20), and add NaHCO3 to the medium.
- step_number: 3
  action: ALIQUOT
  description: Dispense the medium into culture vessels (e.g., 20 ml of the medium
    in 120 ml serum bottles) under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20) gas mixture and seal
    with butyl rubber stoppers.
- step_number: 4
  action: STORE
  description: After autoclaving, stand the medium overnight and adjust pH to 6.5,
    if necessary.
- step_number: 5
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Separately autoclave L-cysteine·HCl and Na2S·9H2O as 5% solutions,
    respectively, under a N2 atmosphere.
- step_number: 6
  action: MIX
  description: Prior to inoculation, aseptically and anaerobically add the L-cysteine·HCl
    and Na2S·9H2O solutions.
